description: Composite TEM figure of Fe-Mn-Al-C low-density steels (LDSs) in four panels of two kinds (bright-field TEM and HRTEM with diffraction insets). (a) Bright-field TEM of the S0 sample, 50 nm scale bar: a dark matrix containing numerous bright, roughly equiaxed nanoparticles indicated by yellow arrows and labelled "κ-carbide"; green dashed lines mark a planar band crossing the field and a green square boxes one particle on it. (a1) HRTEM image, 2 nm scale bar, with lattice fringes and an inset FFT (5 1/nm); the inset carries a red dashed box indexed (002), (111), (222) labelled ZA_γ=[110] and a yellow box indexed (111), (220), (222) labelled ZA_κ=[110], i.e. the γ/κ orientation relationship. (a2) Bright-field TEM, 500 nm scale bar, of S0 showing a dark planar boundary (ATB) separating regions of austenitic matrix, with a red circle and dashed arrow pointing to an inset SAED (5 1/nm) indexed (111), (002), (11-1), ZA_matrix=[110]. (b) Bright-field TEM after heat treatment, 500 nm scale bar: a boundary decorated with dense needle/plate-like features, adjacent matrix containing dislocations; red circle/arrow mark the inset SAED indexed (111), (220), (11-1), (220) with ZA_matrix=[110] and ZA_twin=[110]. Together the panels identify nanoscale κ-carbide in an austenitic matrix, a high dislocation density in S0, and twin/ATB-related structure after solution treatment. No numeric d-spacings or intensities are printed; only scale bars and zone-axis labels.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a bright-field TEM image with a 50 nm scale bar showing a dark matrix containing many bright, roughly equiaxed nanoparticles, each indicated by a yellow arrow, with the text label 'κ-carbide' printed in the lower-central region.
In panel (a) a green dashed line traces a planar band crossing the image from upper-right to lower-left, and a green square outlines one bright particle located on that band.

Panel (a1) is an HRTEM image with a 2 nm scale bar showing lattice fringes, with an inset FFT (scale bar 5 1/nm) containing a red dashed box indexed (002), (111), (222) (labelled γ) and a yellow dashed box indexed (111), (220), (222) (labelled κ), with the zone-axis labels ZA_γ=[110] and ZA_κ=[110].

Panel (a2) is a bright-field TEM image with a 500 nm scale bar showing a dark planar boundary separating regions of matrix, with dislocation lines/tangles visible in the matrix; a red circle and dashed arrow mark the region from which the inset SAED pattern (5 1/nm scale bar) was taken.

Panel (b) is a bright-field TEM image with a 500 nm scale bar showing a boundary decorated with dense needle- or plate-like features, and the inset SAED (5 1/nm scale bar) from the red-circled region is indexed (111), (220), (11-1), (220) with zone-axis labels ZA_matrix=[110] and ZA_twin=[110].
The caption states that (a-a1) show TEM morphology and HRTEM image of κ-carbide in the S0 sample, (a2) shows the dislocation morphology of S0, and (b) shows twin morphology after heat treatment.
The citing text states that κ-carbides in the S0 sample have diameters ranging from 5 to 10 nm and are indicated by yellow arrows in Fig. 5a, with FFT analysis given in Fig. 5a1.
The citing text states that the matrix of the LDSs is predominantly austenitic and contains a high density of irregularly distributed dislocations in the S0 sample.

The citing text states that the dislocation density decreases after solution treatment, and that dislocation tangles are observed adjacent to the ATBs, suggesting the abundant ATBs hinder dislocation movement (attributed to Fig. 5b).

The caption describes panel (b) as 'twin morphology after heat treatment', whereas the citing sentence describes Fig. 5b in terms of decreased dislocation density and dislocation tangles adjacent to ATBs; the two descriptions emphasize different features of the same panel.

No numeric values (d-spacings, intensities, κ-carbide size) are printed anywhere in the panels; the only printed numbers are the scale-bar lengths (50 nm, 2 nm, 500 nm) and the reciprocal-space scale (5 1/nm) in the SAED/FFT insets.

subfigures.description: Bright-field TEM of the S0 sample, 50 nm scale bar, showing a dark matrix with numerous bright nanoscale particles marked by yellow arrows and labelled 'κ-carbide'; green dashed lines trace a planar band and a green square highlights one particle.

HRTEM image (2 nm scale bar) of a κ-carbide/matrix region with visible lattice fringes; inset FFT (5 1/nm) with a red dashed box indexed (002), (111), (222) labelled ZA_γ=[110] and a yellow dashed box indexed (111), (220), (222) labelled ZA_κ=[110].

Bright-field TEM of S0 (500 nm scale bar) with a dark planar boundary (ATB) and dislocation tangles in the adjacent matrix; inset SAED (5 1/nm) indexed (111), (002), (11-1) with ZA_matrix=[110], taken from the red-circled area.

Bright-field TEM after heat treatment (500 nm scale bar) showing a boundary decorated with dense needle/plate-like features and dislocations in the adjacent matrix; inset SAED (5 1/nm) from the red-circled region indexed (111), (220), (11-1), (220) with ZA_matrix=[110] and ZA_twin=[110].

panel (b): the exact wording of the inset SAED zone-axis labels (ZA_matrix=[110], ZA_twin=[110]) is partially readable; the indices themselves are legible
panel (a): individual κ-carbide particle diameters cannot be measured from the printed scale bar alone
